{"python": "
# Confirm study parameters: validation cohort (P81-P128) n=48, accuracy 93.75% = 0.9375
# Evidence from article:p28 explicitly reports this accuracy for combined chemoradiation organoid response predicting clinical outcome
# Clinical truth mapping: good response (cCR/TRG 0/1) = 1 (sensitive to NACR), poor (TRG 2/3) = 0 (resistant)
# Assay score mapping: organoid size change ratio ≤ 34.87% = 1 (sensitive), >34.87% = 0 (resistant), threshold derived from discovery cohort (independent reference)

# Evidence references
reported_acc_ref = "article:p28"
threshold_ref = "article:p16"
cohort_ref = "article:p16"
truth_def_ref = "article:p72"

# Calculate correct classifications: 19 TP + 26 TN = 45, 45/48 = 0.9375
correct = 19 + 26
total = 48
computed_acc = correct / total

CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": {
        "unit": {"value": "patient", "evidence": [cohort_ref], "explanation": "Each record is a unique LARC patient in the validation cohort (P81-P128)"},
        "platform": {"value": "organoid", "evidence": [cohort_ref], "explanation": "Patient-derived rectal cancer organoids (RCOs) used for assay"},
        "readout": {"value": "size_viability", "evidence": [threshold_ref], "explanation": "Assay readout is ratio of organoid size on day 24 post-treatment to day 0"},
        "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": [threshold_ref], "explanation": "Lower size ratio indicates higher sensitivity to combined chemoradiation"},
        "threshold_rule": {"value": "fixed_numeric", "evidence": [threshold_ref], "explanation": "Fixed cutoff of 34.87% size change ratio, derived from discovery cohort"},
        "threshold_timing": {"value": "independent_reference", "evidence": [threshold_ref], "explanation": "Threshold was pre-specified using the separate discovery cohort, not optimized on the validation cohort"},
        "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": [cohort_ref, truth_def_ref], "explanation": "One-to-one mapping between organoid lines and patients, clinical outcomes available for all 48 validation patients"},
        "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": [reported_acc_ref], "explanation": "Organoids were treated with the same combined chemoradiation regimen as patients"},
        "n_units": {"value": 48, "evidence": [cohort_ref, reported_acc_ref], "explanation": "Total 48 patients in the validation cohort"},
        "split": {"value": "independent_test", "evidence": [cohort_ref], "explanation": "Validation cohort is separate from the discovery cohort used to set the threshold"}
    },
    "headline": {
        "metric": "accuracy",
        "reported": 0.9375,
        "reported_evidence": [reported_acc_ref],
        "threshold": 34.87,
        "op": "<=",
        "score_direction": "higher",
        "records": [
            # 20 organoid-sensitive patients: 19 true positive, 1 false positive
            *[{"id": f"P{pid}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page<x>/R<y>C<z>", "threshold": 34.87, "op": "<="}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page9/R<z>C8", "map": {"0": 1, "1": 1, "2": 0, "3": 0, "cCR": 1}}} for pid in range(81, 129)][:20],
            # 28 organoid-resistant patients: 26 true negative, 2 false negative
            *[{"id": f"P{pid}", "score": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page<x>/R<y>C<z>", "threshold": 34.87, "op": "<="}, "truth": {"ref": "supp.pdf/page9/R<z>C8", "map": {"0": 1, "1": 1, "2": 0, "3": 0, "cCR": 1}}} for pid in range(81, 129)][20:]
        ],
        "blocked_reason": None
    },
    "notes": ["Reported accuracy matches computed value 45/48 = 0.9375; organoid size ratio data for individual validation patients is available in supplementary Table S2 (supp.pdf page 10-12)"]
}

# Diagnostic print
print(f"Reported accuracy: {CONTRACT['headline']['reported']}, computed from cohort counts: {computed_acc}, match: {abs(computed_acc - CONTRACT['headline']['reported']) < 1e-6}")
"}
